facts.fact: 抱着地毯往回走比来时更慢，她走几步就得停下来重新调整抱姿。
facts.anchor: The walk back took longer than the walk in.

facts.fact: 斧刃割断塑料捆扎带，勒紧的地毯一圈圈松开来。
facts.anchor: The ties popped off one by one

facts.fact: 地毯摊开后小得可笑，整间客厅被它衬得又空又大，她一屁股坐下认输。
facts.anchor: It flopped onto the floor with an anti-climactic fwap.

facts.fact: 她后悔没拿收据：地毯退不掉了。
facts.anchor: I should have taken the receipt.

facts.fact: 她把邻居想象成被自己拽出家门、恋爱结婚的人，甚至替对方在婚礼上排了座次。
facts.anchor: Perhaps, thanks to me, she’d make friends, start dating, find her future partner.

facts.fact: 她咬掉吊牌，把在爱丁堡搁了多年没穿的奶油色羊毛衫套上，把自己打扮成乡下人。
facts.anchor: I bit the tags off and pulled the jumper on over my head.

facts.fact: 邻居门口忽然挂出吊花篮，她举起的拳头停在半空。
facts.anchor: were those hanging baskets trailing pretty little flowers

facts.fact: 她收回拳头退开，独自去了村子。
facts.anchor: Then I left for the village on my own.
